raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enable `--enable-layernorm-sp` (Megatron-style LayerNorm sequence parallelism) on the NPU (Ascend) backend. On CUDA the SP fast-path fuses the matmul with the collective using torch's `symm_mem` operators; Ascend has no equivalent, so on NPU the flag previously ran through a slower un-fused reduce-scatter/all-gather (or failed to engage the intended fast path at all). This PR wires an NPU fast-path on top of the CANN **MC2** (Matmul + Collective-Communication) fused kernels — `npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base` / `npu_all_gather_base_mm` — and makes the fused-eligibility decision device-aware, so `--enable-layernorm-sp` on Ascend matches the CUDA fused behavior.
It also removes an NPU startup crash in TP2 caused by the TP memory-balance heuristic, which assumes CUDA idle-capacity semantics that `torch.npu.mem_get_info()` does not model.

## Modifications

- **`layers/layernorm_sp.py`** — probe the CANN MC2 fused ops once at import on NPU (`_HAS_NPU_MC2_FUSED`); route `column_parallel_g_matmul` / `row_parallel_gbar_matmul` through `npu_all_gather_base_mm` / `npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base` using the TP group's HCCL `hcom` handle (`_npu_hccl_comm_name()`), with the existing plain reduce-scatter/all-gather retained as a safe fallback. Make `sp_fused_matmul_eligible()` device-aware: NPU additionally requires the MC2 kernels and 2-D weights, while CUDA keeps using `symm_mem`. The bookkeeping in `initialize_layernorm_sp()` is unchanged in behavior, but now emits an explicit `LayerNorm sequence parallelism (SP) ENABLED` log so activation is observable.
- **`arg_groups/layernorm_sp_hook.py`** — emit a startup warning on NPU that SP semantics are validated only by the NPU e2e test before relying on the flag in production on Ascend.
- **`distributed/bootstrap.py`** — skip `_check_tp_memory_balance` when `device == "npu"` so TP2 model init no longer hard-crashes on Ascend; `pre_model_load_memory` used for KV sizing is unaffected.
No op names, signature, or checkpoint layout change; the fallback keeps the non-NPU behavior byte-for-byte.

## Accuracy Tests

The NPU fast-path is exercised by a dedicated e2e GSM8K test located in a follow-up test branch (`feat/npu-layernorm-sp-tests`), running Qwen3-8B with tp=2, bf16 and `--enable-layernorm-sp`. It asserts both a GSM8K accuracy threshold (≥ 0.85) and that the SP-enabled log marker appears in server startup logs, proving the feature truly engaged rather than silently no-op'ing. The fused and un-fused paths are mathematically equivalent within floating-point reordering noise, so no numerics change is expected.
## Speed Tests and Profiling
On NPU the MC2 fused ops replace separate matmul + reduce-scatter/all-gather with single fused kernels, matching the CUDA fused path and avoiding extra collective round-trips. The fallback path only triggers if the CANN kernels are unavailable. No throughput regression is expected; no extra data copies are introduced.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit` .
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests` .
- [ ] Update documentation according to `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations` .
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy`  and `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed` .
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance` .

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the `https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process` .
2. Get approvals from `https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS`  and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with `https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests`  or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_flags, get_forward, get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import ceil_align, is_npu
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 # Architectures whose decoder layers route attention/MLP through
 # layer boundaries with the standard participant linears, and for which SP
@@ -62,11 +61,18 @@ def initialize_layernorm_sp(*, model_config) -> None:
     """Materialize ``flags.sp.enabled``; runs once per worker after distributed
     setup, alongside ``initialize_dp_attention``."""
     architectures = model_config.hf_config.architectures
-    get_flags().sp.enabled = bool(
+    enabled = bool(
         get_parallel().enable_layernorm_sp
         and architectures
         and architectures[0] in SP_SUPPORTED_ARCHITECTURES
     )
+    get_flags().sp.enabled = enabled
+    if enabled:
+        logger.info(
+            "LayerNorm sequence parallelism (SP) ENABLED for architecture=%s; "
+            "prefill uses reduce_scatter+all_gather via the SP region.",
+            architectures[0],
+        )
 
 
 def layernorm_sp_enabled() -> bool:
@@ -184,23 +190,69 @@ def maybe_exit_gather(
     _HAS_TORCH_SYMM_MEM_FUSED = False
 
 
+# --- NPU (Ascend) MC2 fused matmul+collective fast-path -----------------------
+# torch_npu mirrors the CUDA symm_mem fused ops with the CANN MC2 (Matmul +
+# Collective-Communication) kernels (CANN >= 8.0.RC2):
+#   npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base == ReduceScatter(x1 @ x2)   [row-parallel g-bar]
+#   npu_all_gather_base_mm     == allgather(x1) @ x2       [column-parallel g]
+# They require fp16/bf16, 2-D inputs and the Hccl backend handle (``hcom``).
+# Availability is probed once at import; on non-NPU builds _HAS_NPU_MC2_FUSED is
+# left False so the fallback collective path is used.
+_HAS_NPU_MC2_FUSED = False
+_npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base = None
+_npu_all_gather_base_mm = None
+if is_npu():
+    try:
+        import acl
+        import torch_npu  # noqa: F401
+
+        # arch35 (Ascend 950) MC2 fused ops accumulate at lower GEMM precision
+        # and regress model accuracy; keep the plain collective fallback there.
+        _is_npu_arch35 = acl.rt.get_device_info(0, 601) == (3510, 0)
+        _npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base = getattr(
+            torch_npu, "npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base", None
+        )
+        _npu_all_gather_base_mm = getattr(torch_npu, "npu_all_gather_base_mm", None)
+        _HAS_NPU_MC2_FUSED = (
+            _npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base is not None
+            and _npu_all_gather_base_mm is not None
+            and not _is_npu_arch35
+        )
+    except Exception:
+        _HAS_NPU_MC2_FUSED = False
+
+
+def _npu_hccl_comm_name() -> str:
+    """HCCL communicator handle (``hcom``) of the TP group, consumed by the MC2
+    fused ops. ``device_group`` is the raw torch ProcessGroup; the Hccl backend
+    exposes ``get_hccl_comm_name`` for the global rank."""
+    tp_group = get_parallel().tp_group
+    backend = tp_group.device_group._get_backend(torch.device("npu"))
+    return backend.get_hccl_comm_name(tp_group.rank)
+
+
 def sp_fused_matmul_eligible(linear) -> bool:
     """Whether the selected fused matmul+collective path applies.
 
-    Muse Spark selects CUTLASS; other models keep the Torch symmetric-memory
-    path. Both require an unquantized, bias-free bf16/fp16 linear. The decision
-    depends only on static layer properties and is identical across TP ranks.
+    Muse Spark selects CUTLASS; NPU/Ascend uses the CANN MC2 fused ops; other
+    models keep the Torch symmetric-memory path. All paths require an
+    unquantized, bias-free bf16/fp16 linear. The decision depends only on
+    static layer properties and is identical across TP ranks.
     """
-    if (
-        not (_HAS_TORCH_SYMM_MEM_FUSED or getattr(linear, "_sp_use_cutlass", False))
-        or linear.bias is not None
-    ):
+    if linear.bias is not None:
         return False
     from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import UnquantizedLinearMethod
 
     if not isinstance(linear.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod):
         return False
-    return linear.weight.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+    if linear.weight.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+        return False
+    if is_npu():
+        # CANN MC2 fused ops are 2-D-only (matmul over 2-D [m, k] x [k, n]).
+        return _HAS_NPU_MC2_FUSED and linear.weight.ndim == 2
+    if getattr(linear, "_sp_use_cutlass", False):
+        return True
+    return _HAS_TORCH_SYMM_MEM_FUSED
 
 
 def column_parallel_g_matmul(
@@ -215,6 +267,18 @@ def column_parallel_g_matmul(
     """
     num_tokens = sp_num_tokens()
     if sp_fused_matmul_eligible(linear):
+        if is_npu():
+            # CANN MC2: allgather(input shard) @ weight.t(), then narrow.
+            try:
+                mm_out, _ = _npu_all_gather_base_mm(
+                    input_parallel.contiguous(),
+                    linear.weight.t().contiguous(),
+                    _npu_hccl_comm_name(),
+                    linear.tp_size,
+                )
+                return mm_out[:num_tokens]
+            except Exception:
+                pass  # fall through to the plain all-gather + matmul below.
         if getattr(linear, "_sp_use_cutlass", False):
             from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.sp_collective_gemm import all_gather_matmul
 
@@ -251,6 +315,19 @@ def row_parallel_gbar_matmul(linear, input_: torch.Tensor, bias) -> torch.Tensor
     if padded != num_tokens:
         x = torch.nn.functional.pad(x, (0, 0, 0, padded - num_tokens))
     if sp_fused_matmul_eligible(linear):
+        if is_npu():
+            # CANN MC2: ReduceScatter(x @ weight.t()). x's padded token dim is
+            # already a multiple of tp_size (required by the fused op).
+            try:
+                return _npu_mm_reduce_scatter_base(
+                    x,
+                    linear.weight.t().contiguous(),
+                    _npu_hccl_comm_name(),
+                    tp_size,
+                    reduce_op="sum",
+                )
+            except Exception:
+                pass  # fall through to matmul + plain reduce-scatter below.
         if getattr(linear, "_sp_use_cutlass", False):
             from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.sp_collective_gemm import matmul_reduce_scatter
